regenerated.distribution_is_unchanged: Target temperature, the sqrt(k_B T/m) Gaussian width, centre-of-mass removal and the 3N-3 rescale are untouched.
regenerated.explanation: temperature_mean 120.41 -> 119.74 K and stddev 22.00 -> 18.72 K. The mean stays pinned to the run's 120 K target, as it must; the standard deviation is a fluctuation measure over a 32-atom system and varies between samples.
regenerated.generated_at_commit_note: Generated by the same commit that made the correction. The long dynamics cases are not part of CTest, so a stale baseline here would not surface as a red commit; regenerating alongside the fix is what keeps the tree consistent at every commit.
regenerated.generated_at_commit_subject: fix: make random velocity initialization rank independent
regenerated.rank_independence: The field is now identical at np=1, 2 and 4 and under a reversed local storage order, to within 2.8e-17 -- reduction round-off in the shared centre-of-mass shift and scale factor. Before the correction all 24 atoms of the equivalence fixture differed, worst component 4.7e-01.
regenerated.reason: Random velocity initialization was rewritten so that an atom's draw is a function of its stable global tag rather than of its position in local storage. That is a different random stream: std::mt19937 advanced in traversal order with std::normal_distribution has been replaced by a counter-based SplitMix64 key over (seed, stream, atom tag, component) with a Box-Muller transform. Every trajectory that starts from randomly sampled velocities therefore starts from a different -- equally valid -- sample of the same Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution, and moves. This is NOT a correction to the distribution: the target temperature, the sqrt(k_B T/m) width, the centre-of-mass removal and the 3N-3 rescale are all unchanged, and tests/velocity_init_tests.cpp verifies the whole field against an independent reimplementation of the specification. The old serial stream is deliberately not preserved: keeping it would have meant keeping traversal order as the random identity, which is the defect.
regenerated.rng_new: SplitMix64 keyed on (seed, stream, global atom tag, component), Box-Muller
regenerated.rng_old: std::mt19937 advanced in local storage order, std::normal_distribution
regenerated.serial_compatibility: Serial results change. The old serial stream is not preserved, because preserving it would mean keeping traversal order as the random identity.
regenerated.static_baselines_unaffected: static_lj_cluster, static_special_pairs, static_coulomb, static_bonded_reference and pme_external were re-run and pass unchanged: none of them assigns velocities.

superseded_regeneration.explanation: temperature_mean falls from 123.81 K to 120.41 K and temperature_stddev rises from 15.66 K to 22.00 K. Both are the expected signature of a ten times stronger thermostat: tighter coupling pulls the mean closer to the 120 K target of the run input, and drives larger instantaneous excursions about it because the friction variable now responds on a 100 fs timescale rather than a 1018 fs one. temperature_stddev is the only metric in this repository that moved OUTSIDE its existing tolerance (6.34 K against a 5.0 K bound), so this case would have failed without regeneration.
superseded_regeneration.generated_at_commit_note: Generated by the same commit that made the correction; the provenance block was written alongside the numeric rows and changes no value.
superseded_regeneration.generated_at_commit_subject: fix: convert thermostat and barostat relaxation times to internal units
superseded_regeneration.internal_time_unit_source: T = A*sqrt(amu/eV) = sqrt(m_u/e)*1e5 fs; see include/gmd/core/physical_constants.hpp
superseded_regeneration.nve_is_unchanged: validation/nve_lj_fluid is NOT regenerated and is proved unchanged: its run input sets no thermostat and no barostat, so the tau correction cannot reach it, and its metric is a difference of two energies printed at six decimals which the 4.206204e-07 timestep change does not move. Re-running it returns 4.687499999993846e-08, bit-identical to the stored value.
superseded_regeneration.reason: The Nose-Hoover coupling time is now honoured in femtoseconds. It previously reached the thermostat as a raw femtosecond number while the friction variable was integrated against a dt in internal time units, so a requested tau of 100 fs acted as 100 internal units = 1018.05 fs -- exactly T = 10.180505717871194 times too long, and the thermostat mass Q = dof*k_B*T*tau^2 was T^2 = 103.6427 times too large. The correction makes the thermostat about ten times more strongly coupled, which is a real change in the dynamics these cases sample, not a numerical drift. The internal time unit itself was also corrected from 1.018051e+1 to 10.180505717871194 fs (+4.206204e-07 relative on dt), which alone would have moved these metrics only at the 1e-5 level.
superseded_regeneration.static_baselines_unaffected: No static energy, force or virial baseline involves time; none is regenerated and none changes.

superseded_regeneration.coulomb_constant_unrelated: Static energy, force and virial baselines are NOT regenerated and do not change: no Coulomb, Lennard-Jones or bonded quantity depends on k_B.
superseded_regeneration.explanation: temperature_mean moves by 1.079e-07 relative and temperature_stddev by 1.912e-06. The mean tracks the thermostat target almost exactly, so it moves at roughly the size of the constant change itself; the standard deviation is a fluctuation measure over a chaotic trajectory and moves more.
superseded_regeneration.generated_at_commit_subject: fix: use an authoritative Boltzmann constant
superseded_regeneration.reason: The velocity initializer's Boltzmann constant was corrected from 8.617343e-5 to the authoritative 8.617333262145177e-5, a relative change of -1.130030e-06. Maxwell-Boltzmann sampling draws sigma = sqrt(k_B T/m) and the rescale that follows targets 2K = dof k_B T, so every initial velocity is scaled by sqrt of that ratio, -5.650e-07 relative. These runs start from randomly sampled velocities, so the whole trajectory moves.
superseded_regeneration.still_within_previous_tolerance_note: Every metric stayed inside the case's existing tolerance, so this case would have passed without regeneration. It is regenerated anyway because the stored values had reproduced bit-for-bit and no longer do; leaving them would turn an exact baseline into an approximate one without saying so.
